About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Role summary

The Senior Manager, GTM FP&A – Marketing & Channel is the finance business partner to the Marketing & Channel organizations, which together drive lead generation and pipeline for the sales organization. The role owns marketing and channel spend planning, return on investment (ROI) analysis, partner economics, and demand funnel and unit-economics analytics, including CAC, LTV, leads, MQLs, partner-sourced pipeline, and conversion rates, and turns the numbers into a clear narrative for Marketing and Channel leadership, QBRs, and board content. It is a hands-on individual contributor role that works closely with Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, Strategic Finance, and the broader FP&A team, and partners with the Center of Excellence (CoE) on organizational spend planning.

What you will do

  • Own the Marketing budget and forecast. Build the annual Marketing budget and monthly spend forecast across headcount, programs, events, media, and tools. Track budget vs. actuals and flag risks and opportunities to leadership.

  • Measure marketing ROI. Build ROI and payback analyses by program, channel, campaign, and event, and recommend where to shift spend for the best return.

  • Own CAC and unit economics. Calculate and report CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, and CAC payback by segment, region, and channel, and explain what drives the changes.

  • Analyze the demand funnel. Track leads, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and bookings, along with conversion rates and velocity at each stage, and explain variances against plan and prior forecast.

  • Build the demand and pipeline model. Develop bottoms-up models that link marketing spend and lead volume to pipeline and bookings targets, and size the investment needed to hit plan.

  • Own the Channel forecast. Build bottoms-up forecasts for partner-sourced and partner-influenced leads, pipeline, and bookings, and track partner contribution from lead to bookings to renewal.

  • Model deal and partner economics. Model partner-tier margins, MDF ROI, and co-sell deal structures, and measure partner profitability and channel contribution.

  • Lead quarterly results reporting. Own the Marketing and Channel results commentary for QBRs and board content, covering spend, efficiency, funnel, and partner performance.

  • Lead strategic planning. Develop forward-looking analytical frameworks for marketing and channel investment and growth, and build the Marketing and Channel targets that roll up to the annual and long-range plan.

  • Manage spend controls. Partner with Marketing Ops, Procurement, and Accounting on vendor contracts, accruals, program spend, and MDF so actuals are accurate and on time.

  • Provide decision support. Lead scenario and what-if analyses on program mix, partner programs, headcount, and new campaign or market investments, along with pricing, packaging, and segmentation analyses for channel motions, and contribute, with Strategic Finance, to resource allocation decisions.

  • Partner across Finance. Work closely with Sales Ops, Strategic Finance, and the broader FP&A team to keep Marketing and Channel plans, forecasts, and reporting aligned with company-wide numbers.

What You'll Bring:

 

  • 8–12 years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, including 3+ years supporting Marketing, Channel/Partner, or GTM organizations at a SaaS or cybersecurity company.

  • Track record building marketing ROI, CAC, funnel, and channel analytics frameworks at $500M+ ARR scale; IPO or pre-IPO experience preferred.

  • Deep knowledge of SaaS marketing and GTM metrics: CAC, LTV, CAC payback, leads, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, conversion rates, attribution, and partner economics.

  • Experience with marketing attribution models and marketing automation data (such as HubSpot) is a plus.

  • Strong financial modeling skills, including budgeting, ROI, scenario, funnel, and deal economics models.

  • Strong systems fluency, including NetSuite, Salesforce, and Adaptive or Anaplan, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

  • Ability to translate complex data into an executive-ready narrative for Marketing, Channel, and board audiences.

  • Track record of strong cross-functional partnerships with Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, Strategic Finance, and business leaders, with a hands-on approach.

For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA a plus.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.
